startup_idea: A vertical B2B SaaS platform specifically built for residential solar installations in Tier-2 Indian cities to manage site surveys, inventory, and government subsidy filings.

idea_analysis.one_line_description: Vertical B2B SaaS platform for residential solar installations in Tier-2 Indian cities to manage site surveys, inventory, and government subsidy filings.
idea_analysis.problem_statement: Residential solar installers in Tier-2 Indian cities lack integrated tools to efficiently conduct site surveys, track inventory, and navigate complex government subsidy processes.
idea_analysis.proposed_solution: A cloud-based SaaS platform that streamlines site survey workflows, inventory management, and subsidy filing for solar installation companies.
idea_analysis.buyer: Operations managers / CFOs of solar installation firms
idea_analysis.beneficiary: End customers (residential homeowners) who receive solar installations
idea_analysis.revenue_model: Monthly/annual subscription fees based on number of users or installations managed
idea_analysis.key_value_proposition: Reduces time and errors in site surveys, inventory tracking, and subsidy filing, enabling installers to focus on installations and increase profitability.
key_assumptions: Solar installers in Tier-2 cities are willing to adopt cloud-based tools
Government subsidy processes can be digitized and integrated
The platform can scale to handle multiple cities' data
critical_unknowns: What is the exact cost of government subsidy filing per installer?
How many installers are currently using manual processes?
What regulatory changes might affect subsidy eligibility?

key_questions_to_answer: What is the total addressable market (TAM) for residential solar installers in Tier-2 cities of Gujarat?
What subscription price can we set to remain competitive while covering CAC and achieving target LTV?
What is the expected churn rate for our SaaS platform in this niche?
What is the cost to acquire a new customer and how does it compare to LTV?
At what point will the business reach break-even and profitability?
